message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) under Chinese criminal law for destroying protected plants. The facts: Defendant destroyed two trees of water willow (水曲柳) which are a national key protected plant. The act is illegal destruction of protected wildlife/plant. The relevant crime is "非法毁坏国家重点保护植物罪". In Chinese criminal law, there is a specific offense: "非法毁坏国家重点保护植物罪". Also possibly "非法采伐、毁坏森林" but the specific is protected plant. So charge: "非法毁坏国家重点保护植物罪". The format: [罪名]非法毁坏国家重点保护植物罪<eoa>. No other charges. Provide JSON with reasoning and final answer.
